verses.1: A slave of God, but also an apostle of Jesus Christ, chosen by God for the purpose of spreading His truth through faith.
verses.2: In the hope of eternal life, which the infallible God had decreed long ago.
verses.3: And he revealed it at different times and in various ways. His words were proclaimed in a message that I believe was given by our Savior, God.
verses.4: May this be known by all children, through common faith. May grace and peace come from God the Father and from Christ Jesus, our Savior.
verses.5: For this reason, they were sent to Crete in order to correct the remaining errors. They were also tasked with establishing representatives for the city, as I have instructed you.
verses.6: Who is the innocent one? It could be a woman or a man who has children and who is not guilty of any sin or misconduct.
verses.7: For the governor must be treated as a godly ruler. He must not be angry, nor irritable, nor harsh, nor cruel, nor resentful.
verses.8: But he was friendly, kind, sensible, just, honest, and worthy of respect.
verses.9: By enduring the teachings of the faithful, he can become strong enough to teach in a healthy manner, and to control those who oppose his teachings.
verses.10: For there are many who are unworthy of respect, fools and pretenders. Most of them are those who engage in such practices as circumcision.
verses.11: It must be confirmed that they rearrange all the houses, while teaching people not to be greedy for rewards.
verses.12: Some of them said that they had a prophet among them. But they are always deceivers; they’re evil creatures, slow-witted people.
verses.13: This testimony is true. By it, he determined the reason for their destruction, so that they might be saved in the faith.
verses.14: Do not follow the myths and commands of Jews, who try to distort the truth.
verses.15: Everything is pure for those who are pure. But for those who are impure and filthy, nothing is pure either. Their mind and consciousness also become impure.
verses.16: They admit to being gods, but they deny it regarding their own actions. They are wicked and deceitful, and they are not suitable for any good work.
